subject: Tamil (second language)

source.read: CISCE Regulations and Syllabus, ICSE, Second Language: Indian Languages (Classes IX and X)
source.note: Paper structure and marks are CISCE's; Tamil's prescribed textbooks (Appendix I) are the school's and are not reproduced.

licence: Outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.

outcomes.text: Composition (15 marks): writes a composition of the kind set, a narrative, description or explanation.
Letter (7 marks): writes a letter on one of two subjects, with the right layout.
Comprehension (10 marks): answers questions on an unseen passage of about 250 words.
Grammar (8 marks): uses vocabulary, syntax and idiom correctly; joins sentences; forms sentences with given words.
Prescribed texts (40 marks): answers on two of the prescribed textbooks.
outcomes.note: The school's own textbook is not reproduced (it is copyrighted). OpenPath's own stories and poems practise the same questions on character, theme, meaning and poetic devices.

outcomes.text: Explains poetic features such as edhugai.
Internal assessment, writing: a 300-400 word creative piece.
outcomes.note: Our longest task asks for up to 400 words; the school sets the assignment.

outcomes.text: Internal assessment, oral: a prepared speech, debate or role-play.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who listens. The app does not hear or mark speaking.
